pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions; multi-entry scalping must only occur via independent non-correlated ticks with a hard cap of 1 concurrent trade per directional bias.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated multi-timeframe order-flow imbalance score above 75% and zero high-impact liquidity sweeps within the immediate 5-minute window before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively lock in green trades once floating profit hits +$15.00 via trailing dynamic stops, preventing profits from evaporating into minor wins or losses.
